mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slack condition, indicated by unemployment rate exceeding 7.5%, signals weak consumer demand and reduced corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO above 100) signals strong manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies benefit from higher output and margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index above 230 (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and higher real interest rates, which depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) reflects a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 900 thousand units indicate a robust housing market, which is a leading indicator of consumer confidence and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, characterized by high GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.5% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive forward returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates, but the signal weakens as the cycle matures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
